title: wg: room-policy-04 §4 claim id encoding and empty claimset
description: Suggestion. (1) §4 does not define the 'binary representation of an X.509 OID' (DER content octets vs full TLV) or how a CWT integer claim key becomes opaque bytes; implementations extracting claims differently never match. (2) An entry with an empty claimset vacuously matches every requester (incl. all BasicCredential users) and shadows later entries; the text should state whether that is intended or forbid it. mimid implements the literal reading (decision mimid-1wgh.3.47). Fix: define claim_id encodings; address empty claimsets explicitly.
